verdict.rationale: Siskind Susser's O-1 practice page states that an accompanying spouse and children under 21 may be eligible for O-3 visas, so dependent coverage is documented for at least one founder pathway. That is a single eligibility statement, not a description of dependent filings handled as part of the engagement. missing for 10: H-4 dependent coverage, dependent work authorization (e.g., H-4 EAD or spousal EAD), explicit statement that dependent petitions are included in the service, independent or hands-on corroboration.
